units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:1">Ḥag. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Chagigah 11b:7">11ᵇ</cite>) <he>ר׳ לו שלא בא לעולם</he> (Ms. M., a. Var. in Ar. <he>רָאוּי</he>) it would have been a mercy to him not to have been born; (Y. ed. <he>ר׳ לו כאילו לא בא לעולם</he> a pity for him! he is as though he had not been born; Mish. ed. <he>ראוי לו כאילו לא וכ׳</he> he is looked upon as though &c.).
